name: 拖拽排序
desc: 落点语义（某行上半区插到该行之前 / 末行下半区追加末尾）、拖动中只给落点提示（dragging 类 + 落点行 drop-before）且顺序不变、松手才换位并落盘、原位松手不写盘、刷新后顺序保持

steps.eval: if (typeof T === 'undefined') { window.T = {}; } T.wipe = async () => { const { getStorage } = await import('/nos/storage/main.js'); const s = getStorage('conjure-todo-app'); const K = '__todo_test_backup_v1'; if (localStorage.getItem('__todo_test_dirty') === '1') { const o = JSON.parse(localStorage.getItem(K) || 'null'); if (o) { if (o.todos) await s.setItem('todos', o.todos); if (o.groups) await s.setItem('groups', o.groups); if (o.ui) await s.setItem('ui', o.ui); } } const snap = { todos: await s.getItem('todos'), groups: await s.getItem('groups'), ui: await s.getItem('ui') }; localStorage.setItem(K, JSON.stringify(snap)); localStorage.setItem('__todo_test_dirty', '1'); await s.removeItem('todos'); await s.removeItem('groups'); await s.removeItem('ui'); sessionStorage.removeItem('todo-ui-state'); return 'wiped, backup todos=' + (snap.todos ? snap.todos.length : 0); }; return await T.wipe();

if (typeof T === 'undefined') { window.T = {}; } T.q = (s) => { const p = document.querySelector('o-page'); const r = p && p.shadowRoot; return r ? Array.from(r.querySelectorAll(s)) : []; }; T.ready = async (sel, ms) => { const n = Math.ceil((ms || 3000) / 100); for (let i = 0; i < n; i++) { if (T.q(sel).length) return true; await new Promise((r) => setTimeout(r, 100)); } throw new Error('页面就绪超时，找不到 ' + sel); }; T.tx = (el) => el.textContent.trim(); T.click = (el) => { if (!el) throw new Error('元素不存在'); const b = el.shadowRoot && el.shadowRoot.querySelector('button'); (b || el).click(); return true; }; T.byText = (sel, t) => T.q(sel).find((e) => T.tx(e) === t) || null; T.btn = (t) => T.click(T.byText('st-button', t)); T.dlg = () => T.q('st-dialog').find((d) => d.hasAttribute('open')) || null; T.dlgBtn = (t) => { const d = T.dlg(); if (!d) throw new Error('当前没有打开的弹窗'); return T.click(Array.from(d.querySelectorAll('st-button')).find((b) => T.tx(b) === t)); }; T.wait = (ms) => new Promise((r) => setTimeout(r, ms || 300)); T.NL = String.fromCharCode(10); T.setVal = (el, v) => { if (!el) throw new Error('输入元素不存在'); el.value = v; el.dispatchEvent(new Event('input', { bubbles: true })); return true; }; T.addTask = async (title, desc) => { T.btn('添加任务'); await T.wait(350); const d = T.dlg(); if (!d) throw new Error('添加弹窗未打开'); T.setVal(d.querySelector('.dialog-field'), desc ? title + T.NL + desc : title); await T.wait(250); T.dlgBtn('添加'); await T.wait(400); return true; }; T.items = () => T.q('.item'); T.titles = () => T.items().map((i) => T.tx(i.querySelector('.text'))); T.need = (t) => { const i = T.items().find((x) => T.tx(x.querySelector('.text')) === t); if (!i) throw new Error('找不到任务：' + t); return i; }; T.drag = async (fromTitle, toTitle, where) => { const a = T.need(fromTitle); const b = T.need(toTitle); const h = a.querySelector('.drag-handle'); const hr = h.getBoundingClientRect(); const mk = (ev, x, y) => new PointerEvent(ev, { bubbles: true, cancelable: true, button: 0, pointerId: 1, pointerType: 'mouse', clientX: x, clientY: y }); h.dispatchEvent(mk('pointerdown', hr.left + 5, hr.top + 5)); await T.wait(200); const tr = b.getBoundingClientRect(); const y = where === 'after' ? tr.bottom - 2 : tr.top + 2; window.dispatchEvent(mk('pointermove', tr.left + 40, y)); await T.wait(200); window.dispatchEvent(mk('pointerup', tr.left + 40, y)); await T.wait(450); return true; }; return 'helpers ready';

await T.ready('.add-group-btn'); await T.addTask('A', ''); await T.addTask('B', ''); await T.addTask('C', ''); const order = T.titles().join(','); if (order !== 'C,B,A') throw new Error('初始顺序不正确：' + order); const h = T.need('A').querySelector('.drag-handle'); if (!h) throw new Error('列表行应有拖拽手柄'); if (h.getAttribute('title').indexOf('按住拖动调整顺序') !== 0) throw new Error('手柄 title 不正确：' + h.getAttribute('title')); return 'ok';

const order = () => T.titles().join(','); if (order() !== 'C,B,A') throw new Error('起始顺序应为 C,B,A，实际 ' + order()); await T.drag('A', 'C', 'before'); if (order() !== 'A,C,B') throw new Error('拉到首行上半区应插到该行之前，实际 ' + order()); await T.drag('A', 'B', 'after'); if (order() !== 'C,B,A') throw new Error('拉到末行下半区应追加到末尾，实际 ' + order()); await T.drag('A', 'B', 'before'); if (order() !== 'C,A,B') throw new Error('拉到某行上半区应插到该行之前，实际 ' + order()); return 'ok';

const order = () => T.titles().join(','); const before = order(); const h = T.need('C').querySelector('.drag-handle'); const hr = h.getBoundingClientRect(); const mk = (ev, x, y) => new PointerEvent(ev, { bubbles: true, cancelable: true, button: 0, pointerId: 1, pointerType: 'mouse', clientX: x, clientY: y }); h.dispatchEvent(mk('pointerdown', hr.left + 5, hr.top + 5)); await T.wait(200); if (T.need('C').className.indexOf('dragging') === -1) throw new Error('按下手柄后被拖行应带 dragging 类：' + T.need('C').className); const tr = T.need('B').getBoundingClientRect(); window.dispatchEvent(mk('pointermove', tr.left + 40, tr.top + 2)); await T.wait(300); if (order() !== before) throw new Error('拖动过程中顺序不应变化：' + before + ' → ' + order()); if (T.need('B').className.indexOf('drop-before') === -1) throw new Error('落点行应带 drop-before 类：' + T.need('B').className); window.dispatchEvent(mk('pointerup', tr.left + 40, tr.top + 2)); await T.wait(500); if (order() !== 'A,C,B') throw new Error('松手后顺序应为 A,C,B，实际 ' + order()); const cls = T.need('C').className + ' | ' + T.need('B').className; if (cls.indexOf('dragging') !== -1 || cls.indexOf('drop-') !== -1) throw new Error('松手后应清空拖拽视觉态：' + cls); return 'ok';

const order = () => T.titles().join(','); const before = order(); const h = T.need('C').querySelector('.drag-handle'); const hr = h.getBoundingClientRect(); const mk = (ev, x, y) => new PointerEvent(ev, { bubbles: true, cancelable: true, button: 0, pointerId: 1, pointerType: 'mouse', clientX: x, clientY: y }); h.dispatchEvent(mk('pointerdown', hr.left + 5, hr.top + 5)); await T.wait(200); window.dispatchEvent(mk('pointermove', hr.left + 5, hr.top + 8)); await T.wait(200); window.dispatchEvent(mk('pointerup', hr.left + 5, hr.top + 8)); await T.wait(500); if (order() !== before) throw new Error('落点即原位时顺序不应变化：' + before + ' → ' + order()); return 'ok';

let root = null; for (let i = 0; i < 30; i++) { const p = document.querySelector('o-page'); root = p && p.shadowRoot; if (root && root.querySelector('.shell')) break; await new Promise((r) => setTimeout(r, 100)); } if (!root || !root.querySelector('.shell')) throw new Error('刷新后页面未就绪'); const items = Array.from(root.querySelectorAll('.item')); const order = items.map((i) => i.querySelector('.text').textContent.trim()).join(','); if (order !== 'A,C,B') throw new Error('刷新后顺序应保持，实际 ' + order); if (root.querySelectorAll('.item.dragging').length || root.querySelectorAll('.item.drop-before').length || root.querySelectorAll('.item.drop-after').length) throw new Error('刷新后不应残留拖拽视觉态'); return 'ok';

const { getStorage } = await import('/nos/storage/main.js'); const s = getStorage('conjure-todo-app'); const o = JSON.parse(localStorage.getItem('__todo_test_backup_v1') || 'null'); if (o) { if (o.todos) await s.setItem('todos', o.todos); if (o.groups) await s.setItem('groups', o.groups); if (o.ui) await s.setItem('ui', o.ui); } localStorage.removeItem('__todo_test_dirty'); sessionStorage.removeItem('todo-ui-state'); return 'restored';
